title: Derpy Cats
description: Ever wanted cats to be more DERPY? Well now they CAN BE!
body:
This pack makes cats (and other mobs) DERPY! Affected mobs so far:
- Slimes
- Cats 
- Phantoms
- Tridents (?)

FAQ:
Can you show me how to make packs?


Sure! Message me on PMC about it!


Why aren't my textures working?


I think you downloaded the wrong pack version, you're in the wrong version of Minecraft, or it's simply bugging. Fix _**MOST**_ bugs [here](https://www.convertmcpack.net/pack_fixer.php)


When will there be a new update?


ASAP!


  [Works for all versions 1.17 and up]
  






More info [ here](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/derpy-cats/)
